_comment: Immutable GitHub Actions pin inventory (issue #9 mandatory correction #1). Documentation/evidence only -- never an authorization mechanism; see scripts/release_rehearsal/action_pins.py and docs/release_process.md's 'Immutable Actions pin inventory' section. Every 'pinned_sha' below MUST appear verbatim as the '@ref' of the named 'action' in the named 'workflow' file -- scripts/release_rehearsal/action_pins.py's check() mechanically enforces that exact agreement in both directions (a workflow pin changed without updating this file, or vice versa, both fail closed). 'verification_method'/'verified_on' record the exact one-time, read-only lookup used to establish that 'pinned_sha' really is 'human_version' -- this checker itself never re-executes that lookup (no network access, no 'gh'/git-remote invocation against the upstream action repository).

pins.verification_method: Read-only 'git ls-remote --tags https://github.com/actions/checkout' confirmed both 'refs/tags/v7.0.1' and 'refs/tags/v7' (the mutable major-version tag, not itself trusted or referenced by the pinned workflow) resolve to commit 3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1; cross-checked read-only against 'https://api.github.com/repos/actions/checkout/commits/3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1' (commit exists, message 'prep v7.0.1 release (#2531)') and 'https://api.github.com/repos/actions/checkout/releases/tags/v7.0.1' (tag_name 'v7.0.1', target_commitish 'main'). No network mutation of any kind was performed -- no 'git fetch'/'clone'/push, no authenticated API call, no local ref/remote added.
pins.update_procedure: 1. Decide the new upstream tag to move to (e.g. a newer 'vN.M.P'). 2. Read-only resolve it to an exact commit with 'git ls-remote --tags https://github.com/<action-repo> <tag>' (never 'git fetch'/'git clone' of the upstream action repository, and never any authenticated/mutating GitHub API call). 3. Cross-check that commit against the action repository's own published release notes for that tag (e.g. 'https://github.com/<action-repo>/releases/tag/<tag>', or the read-only 'https://api.github.com/repos/<action-repo>/commits/<sha>' and '.../releases/tags/<tag>' endpoints) to confirm the tag really points at that commit. 4. Update the workflow's 'uses: <action>@<sha>' line to the new SHA (keep the human-readable version as a trailing '# vX.Y.Z' comment). 5. Update this file's matching entry ('pinned_sha', 'human_version', 'source_url', 'verification_method', 'verified_on') in the same change. 6. Run 'make release-workflow-guard' (which also runs 'python3 -m scripts.release_rehearsal.action_pins' -- see release.mk) to mechanically confirm the workflow and this inventory still agree exactly. This procedure is evidence/process documentation only; it grants no publication authority by itself.
